pattern: を中心に（をちゅうしんに）
purpose: Describe something organized around a central place, person, or concern.
keywords: Noun + を中心に / を中心として
Shops are clustered around the station.
Its popularity spread mainly among young people.
We reviewed the plan with safety measures as its main focus.
formation: Noun + を中心に / を中心として
restrictions: The center may be geographical or organizational.
mistake: This indicates a focus, not necessarily the exact physical middle.
